title: The Water That Almost Got You Killed (3D cut)

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: There were forty gallons of clean water in this gas station. Finding them almost got you killed.
lines.tts: [urgent, low] There were forty gallons of clean water in this gas station. Finding them almost got you killed.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day nineteen. Your last bottle is empty.
lines.tts: [tired] Day nineteen. Your last bottle is empty.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: But FEMA lists a hidden water source in almost every building. The water heater.
lines.tts: [conspiratorial] But FEMA lists a hidden water source in almost every building. The water heater.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Forty gallons, in the back room. You open the drain valve. Clean water. Weeks more.
lines.tts: [relieved] Forty gallons, in the back room. You open the drain valve. Clean water. Weeks more.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: But to reach it, you dragged the shelves off the back door. And you never put them back.
lines.tts: [ominous] But to reach it, you DRAGGED the shelves off the back door. And you never put them back.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: 3 a.m. The back door clicks open.
lines.tts: [whispering] Three A M. The back door clicks open.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: One of them is inside. Between you and everything you own.
lines.tts: [tense] One of them is inside. Between you and everything you own.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You run for the walk-in cooler and hold the door shut.
lines.tts: [urgent] You run for the walk-in cooler and hold the door shut.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Dark. Freezing. Your breath turns to fog. And it's scratching at the door.
lines.tts: [whispering, tense] Dark. Freezing. Your breath turns to fog. And it's scratching at the door.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: On your belt: the cashier's handset, wired to the speakers outside.
lines.tts: [thoughtful] On your belt: the cashier's handset, wired to the speakers outside.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You see, they hunt by sound. And the loudest thing for a mile is pump four.
lines.tts: [knowing] You see, they hunt by sound. And the loudest thing for a mile is pump four.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You press the button and bang it on the wall.
lines.tts: [determined] You press the button and bang it on the wall.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: It turns. It follows the noise out the back door, into the rain. You slam the door and bury it under every shelf you own.
lines.tts: [fast, intense] It turns. It follows the noise out the back door, into the rain. You slam the door and bury it under every shelf you own.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You survived your mistake. But you just told the whole county where you are.
lines.tts: [low, ominous] You survived your mistake. But you just told the whole county where you are.
